articles.title: Kejriwal E20 protest Live: Kejriwal to march to PM's residence against E20; cops deny permission
articles.description: Arvind Kejriwal E20 march live: Arvind Kejriwal on Monday announced that he would lead a march of 100 people to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's residence on Tuesday to submit public petitions opposing E20 petrol. The AAP national convener alleged that the Centre was promoting ethanol-blended fuel under pressure from US President Donald Trump, claiming India had "yielded" to buy ethanol from the United States. Addressing a press conference, Kejriwal questioned why the government continued to push E20 despite complaints from vehicle owners, alleging there was a "hidden agenda" behind the policy. He said the delegation would personally hand over the petitions to the Prime Minister and seek a discussion on the concerns surrounding ethanol-blended petrol. Follow this space for all the live updates.
